claude.performance_metric: BPP $219.9M goodwill/intangibles impairment (FY2011); Carlyle 14.4% minority bought out Q1 FY2013 for $42.5M cash + contingent payment
claude.rationale: p4_pathway=1: the acquired international institutions could not be aligned with operations over time, evidenced by successive goodwill/intangibles impairments (BPP $219.9M in FY2011; UNIACC $16.8M in FY2012) and the Apollo Global segment operating at a loss across the window. p5_pathway=1: documented operations-vs-organization fracture is shown by the divestiture of acquired sub-institution MPW (FY2012, $26.7M gain in discontinued operations) plus workforce reductions to reengineer processes and continued restructuring after August 31, 2013 (~500 non-faculty personnel). t1_archetype and t2_model are uncertain because the slice documents no controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility separate from these pathways.

gemini.performance_metric: minority partner fully exited for $42.5 million cash plus contingent payment
gemini.rationale: The slice reports significant goodwill impairments ($219.9 million for BPP, $16.8 million for UNIACC) and operating losses, but does not explicitly document product/process incoherence. It also notes workforce reductions to reengineer business processes and the divestiture of MPW, but lacks specific evidence of process/organization fracture.

openai.performance_metric: 14.4% minority interest bought out for $42.5 million cash plus contingent payment, yielding 100% ownership
